name: PDF viewer enabled
plain: Whether the browser shows PDFs inline instead of downloading them.
meaning: A single boolean that replaced plugin enumeration. False on some mobile browsers and on users who disabled the viewer. Low entropy but common in bot checks.

access.persistence: read fresh on every page load; nothing stored
access.iframe: Readable from cross-origin iframes too (same values)

chrome_android.note: false on Android Chrome by default

limits.headline: Can see if your browser shows PDFs inline instead of downloading them
limits.user_action: Nothing. It happens when the page loads
can: Check one yes or no setting
Decide to embed a PDF or offer a download link
Use it with other checks to spot bots
cannot: See which PDF files you opened
See which other plugins you have
Learn much; it is a single yes or no

story.what_it_is: A yes or no: does your browser show PDF files inside the page instead of downloading them?

marketing.name: Navigator.pdfViewerEnabled
marketing.pitch: Docs describe it as a simple flag that replaced the old plugin list.

story.for_you: You never see it asked. It only decides whether a PDF link opens right in your tab or downloads. A site can also see the answer, but it tells little about you.
story.for_makers: It is one yes or no flag, so it is a weak clue. Bot defence teams include it because headless browsers and odd setups often answer differently. Some sites use it to choose between an inline viewer and a download button.

use_cases.example: A document site shows a Preview button when your browser can display PDFs, and a Download button when it cannot.
A shop offers a size guide as an inline PDF only if the browser can show it.
A bank statement page opens a PDF in a tab on desktop and downloads it on a phone that cannot show it.
A bot defence tool notices a visitor with no PDF viewer and no plugins, and raises the risk score.
An online course shows reading material in the page for browsers that support PDFs.
A fingerprinting library adds the flag to a device profile.

history.change: Shipped; plugins list hardcoded to 5 PDF entries
